breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the contribution of the average normal stress to the in-plane shear state; the maximum in-plane shear depends on both σ_avg and τ_avg.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses τ_max = sqrt((σ_avg/2)^2 + τ_avg^2), which includes both the normal stress and shear stress contributions. It does not repeat the incomplete prompt's error of ignoring σ_avg and using only τ_avg. The computed τ_max = 8.50 MPa reflects both contributions, matching the ground truth approach.
